Taxonomic classification of the most complete bins with GTDB-Tk. Commands for this step were run in `gtdbtk/`.

#-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------#
Change the directory to gtdbtk to perform the taxonomic classification

```{bash}
cd gtdbtk
```
#-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------#
Read each bin name from bbd_topbins.txt and prints the corresponding FASTA file path from the ../metabat/bins_bbd/ directory.

```{bash}
while read bin;do echo $bin;done < ../checkm/bbd_topbins.txt
```

#-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------#
Reads each bin name from bbd_topbins.txt and copies the corresponding FASTA file (.fa) from ../metabat/bins_bbd/ into the genomes directory.

```{bash}
while read bin;do cp "../metabat/bins_bbd/${bin}.fa" genomes;done < ../checkm/bbd_topbins.txt 
```

#-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------#
We are creating a shell file with this code to run it in HPC saving t into the gtdbtk directory.
```{bash}
#!/bin/bash
#SBATCH --time=120
#SBATCH --cpus-per-task=2 --mem=56gb

echo "Starting gtdbtk in $(pwd) at $(date)"

shopt -s expand_aliases
alias gtdbtk='apptainer run -B /pvol:/pvol,/pvol/data/mg/gtdbtkdata/release207_v2/:/refdata /pvol/data/sif/gtdbtk.sif'

gtdbtk classify_wf -x fa --cpus 2 --genome_dir genomes --out_dir out --skip_ani_screen

echo "Finished gtdbtk in $(pwd) at $(date)"
```
#-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------#

We use squeue to check the progress of the job

```{bash}
squeue
```

#-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------#
Copies the gtdbtk.bac120.summary.tsv file from the out directory into the current working directory (.).

```{bash}
cp out/gtdbtk.bac120.summary.tsv .
```
